# Acceptance Artifact (auto-generated by /implement)

Every `/implement` run **must** create or update `.qa/acceptance/<feature-slug>.md` **before writing code**.

This file is the contract for `@verify-ui` and `@verify-ticket`. The user never copies templates manually.

## When to skip (rare)

Skip acceptance file **only** when ALL apply:

- Pure refactor with zero behavior/UX change
- Typo or comment-only change
- Docs-only change outside `.qa/`

State `Acceptance artifact: SKIPPED (<reason>)` in the final report.

## Feature slug

Derive kebab-case slug (max 48 chars):

| Priority | Source | Example |
|----------|--------|---------|
| 1 | User-stated feature name | "element effects" → `element-effects` |
| 2 | Git branch | `feat/game-setup` → `game-setup` |
| 3 | Main component/area | `GameView.tsx` → `game-view` |
| 4 | Fallback | `change-YYYY-MM-DD` |

Never use `_template` as slug.

## Output path

```
.qa/acceptance/<feature-slug>.md
```

Create `.qa/acceptance/` if missing. Ensure `.qa/project.yaml` exists (copy from verify-ui template if absent).

## File template

```markdown
# Feature: <human-readable title>

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on YYYY-MM-DD — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
<1–3 sentences from conversation: what the user wants and why>

## Preconditions
<!-- Hoare: what must be true before Happy Path runs (@foundations) -->
- <project open, scene exists, user role, data seeded, etc.>

## Happy Path
<!-- Each item = observable postcondition, not "works correctly" -->
- [ ] <concrete, testable step — given Pre, after action, then …>
- [ ] …

## Edge Cases
<!-- Precondition violated or failure mode handled -->
- [ ] <from conversation + .qa/edge-cases.md subset>
- [ ] …

## Regression
- [ ] <adjacent flows that must still work — nav, modals, API>
- [ ] …

## Assumptions
- <minor ambiguities resolved, or "none">

## Screenshots
| Step | Filename |
|------|----------|
| 1 | `01-<short-name>.png` |
| 2 | `02-<short-name>.png` |

## Implementation Notes
<!-- filled after coding -->
- Files touched: …
- Unit tests: …
```

## Content sources (read before writing)

Priority order:

1. `.qa/design/product-roadmap.md` — sprint ID, stufe (A/B/C), scope, exit criteria, tooling; pick next slug from „Nächste empfohlene Tickets“ if user did not specify
2. `.qa/design/<feature-slug>.md` — from `@pingpong-solution` (if present and Ready for /implement: YES)
3. Current user request + recent iteration messages in chat
4. `.qa/edge-cases.md` — pull relevant rows for this feature area
5. `AGENTS.md` — language, constraints, validation
6. Styleguide — UI states, copy language
7. `.qa/project.yaml` — navigation labels for regression checks

If design artifact says **Ready for /implement: NO**, stop and tell user to finish pingpong-solution first.

Include in acceptance file under Intent: `Roadmap: <ID> (Stufe A|B|C) — <sprint name>`.

## Quality rules

- Every Happy Path item must be **observable in browser or test output** (Hoare postcondition)
- Preconditions section required for non-trivial features; skip with reason for trivial fixes
- Avoid vague items ("works correctly") — use "Feuer-Angriff zeigt Burst ~900ms"
- Include at least one Regression item for UI changes
- Screenshot table must map 1:1 to Happy Path + critical Edge Cases
- Write in the project's UI language (from AGENTS/styleguide)

## After coding

Update **Implementation Notes** section with:

- Key files changed
- Tests added/updated
- Known limitations

Do **not** pre-check boxes — `@verify-ui` checks them.

## Commit

Include `.qa/acceptance/<slug>.md` in the same commit/PR as the feature code.
